risks.title: Dependence on U.S.-Mexico economic relations
risks.score_rationale: The risk ranks top in Item 1A, with strong language ("materially negative", "uncertainty"). It is recurring and reinforced by traffic data (61% of flights to the U.S.). The Geopolitical category is critical for airport operations.

risks.title: Internal armed conflicts in Colombia
risks.score_rationale: Clearly highlighted in the text with mention of affected operational areas (El Caraño). Cautious language ("not typically impacted") but real risk in certain regions. Stable trend, moderate weight for Colombian operations.

risks.title: Recurrent risk of natural disasters
risks.score_rationale: Centrally positioned in the text, with concrete examples (hurricanes Irma, Maria, Fiona, earthquakes in Puerto Rico). Strong language ("severely affected", "may be impacted again"). Stable trend, but exacerbated by climate change. The Environmental category is critical for coastal infrastructure.

risks.title: Dependence on international passenger traffic
risks.score_rationale: Detailed quantitative data provided (61% of international passengers to the U.S.). Strategically positioned in the document. Repetitive language and stable trend. The Industrial category is essential for ASR's business model.

risks.title: Perceived safety of tourist destinations
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in the text regarding safety perception in Cancun and the Riviera Maya. Moderate language but real risk. Stable trend, but sensitive to media crises. The Reputation category is important for leisure destinations.

risks.title: Cybersecurity of airport systems
risks.score_rationale: The risk is addressed in Item 16K, with recognition of growing threats. Cautious but structured language. Implicit upward trend. The Cybersecurity category is evolving for critical infrastructure.

risks.title: U.S. customs and immigration regulation
risks.score_rationale: Clearly highlighted in the text with direct impact on passenger traffic. Strong language ("materially negative"). Stable trend but sensitive to political changes. The Regulation category is strategic for cross-border flows.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in the 2025 20-F and 6-K filings. The technology strategy focuses on green infrastructure and environmental governance.
